perspective.limit: This estimates spatial change in edge angles, not camera calibration. Parallel-line confidence and perspective truth require Claude review; absence of a flag is not proof of orthographic projection.

orange.palette_source: Product starting accent values, used only for screening; no Part B tone selection.
orange.limit: Shade, occlusion and unrelated warm material can split or merge an apparent part. Count is a reproducible palette-mask heuristic, not semantic ownership of the accent.

ocr.limit: OCR can confuse engraved marks or simple geometric emblems with glyphs. Flags are automatic exclusions for review, not verified transcription. Screen-frame captions are blank type strokes, so readable glyphs still need review.

review: Claude shortlist pending; this script makes no artistic approval.
